reports.title: Fortinet Reports Strong Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Guidance
section: For the fourth quarter of 2026, Fortinet currently expects:
•Revenue in the range of $2.155 billion to $2.245 billion
•Billings in the range of $2.775 billion to $2.925 billion
•Non-GAAP gross margin in the range of 78.0% to 80.0%
•Non-GAAP operating margin in the range of 35.5% to 37.5%
•Diluted non-GAAP net income per share in the range of $0.93 to $0.95, assuming a non-GAAP effective tax rate of 18%. This assumes a diluted share count of 741 million to 745 million.
